questions.question: What is AgriDron Solutions?
questions.answer: It's a platform for planning and monitoring agricultural spraying operations with drones.

questions.question: How does the platform work?
questions.answer: Set your field and work area, check weather conditions, run the mission, and review the results.

questions.question: What can I do with the platform?
questions.answer: Plan missions, monitor drones in real time, check the weather, and review operation reports.

questions.question: Do I need a drone to use AgriDron?
questions.answer: The platform is designed for farmers and operators. Contact us and we'll help you find the right option for your operation.

questions.question: Can I monitor multiple missions and drones?
questions.answer: Yes. The number of drones and missions available depends on the plan you choose.

questions.question: How do I choose the right plan?
questions.answer: Compare the plans and their features. If you need help, send us a message and our team will guide you.

sections.title: 1. Deontological Framework and Professional Ethical Commitment
paragraphs: AgriDron Solutions bases the design, development, deployment, and operation of its software platform on strict compliance with:
bullets: The ACM / IEEE-CS Software Engineering Code of Ethics and Professional Practice: a primary commitment to the public interest, ensuring that technical decisions prioritize people's physical safety, data reliability, and environmental preservation in agriculture.

The Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP): honest, transparent, and impartial engineering practice, promoting sustainable technological development and the rigorous stewardship of agricultural communities' resources.
sections.alert: All development team members, supervisors, and operators explicitly commit to acting with technical transparency, rigor in estimates, and responsibility for any operational incident.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of the Service and Operational Scope
paragraphs: AgriDron Solutions is a comprehensive solution composed of a web application, a RESTful backend service, and an informational portal (Landing Page), designed for planning, simulating, and monitoring agricultural spraying operations using unmanned aerial vehicles (drones).

The service does not replace official aeronautical licenses or regulations issued by civil aviation authorities (such as the Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil - DGAC in Peru). The technical operator is responsible for holding the corresponding certifications for field flights.

sections.title: 3. Confidentiality and Privacy of Agricultural Data
paragraphs: Cartographic property data, delimited parcel polygons, mission history, crop yields, and agrochemical formulas belong entirely to the owner of the registered farm or agricultural company:
bullets: Property data will not be sold or shared with third parties without explicit authorization.
Data storage includes role-based access controls (Role-Based Access Control).
Integrations with third-party weather services only query geographic coordinates for the sole purpose of forecasting winds and rainfall.

sections.title: 4. Safety in Autonomous Operations and Geofences
paragraphs: To mitigate any risk of chemical drift or collision, the software enforces the following mandatory rules:
bullets: Weather limits: if wind speed exceeds 15 km/h or there is an imminent probability of precipitation, the system will issue preventive alerts recommending postponement of the mission.
Exclusion zones (Geofencing): scheduling spraying flights over drinking water sources, adjacent residential areas, or unauthorized properties is strictly prohibited.
Emergency stop button: in the event of in-flight anomalies, the technical operator in the field must always retain the ability to pause or abort the spraying trajectory.

sections.title: 5. Traceability and Report Integrity
paragraphs: Reports generated by the platform are agronomic audit documents. Deliberate alteration of flight logs, service hours, or applied doses is prohibited. The platform keeps an immutable mission history to guarantee technical certainty for the farmer.
